questions.question: In story S18 (Cut-over: MarmotContext and consumers onto the new stack), is there any vacuous or placeholder production path: a no-op/stub body, a tautological assertion, a frozen stand-in constant, or an optional dependency (injected port, handler, client handle) that silently degrades to non-behavior when not injected? Cite file:line for each injection point in app/src/context/MarmotContext.tsx; app/src/context/ChatStoreContext.tsx; app/src/context/PollStoreContext.tsx; app/src/context/NostrIdentityContext.tsx; app/src/components/** IncomingCallWatcher, groups/*; app/src/hooks/useImageSend.ts, useDecryptedImage.ts and show that omitting the dependency fails loudly rather than succeeding silently.

Could `MarmotContext` be deleted and rewritten without modifying any file outside its `dependencies_allowed` list? If not, which cross-module dependencies exist and do they flow through declared seam contracts in architecture.md (imports only via each module's index.ts, no React-context imports under app/src/lib/marmot/**, no ts-mls or @internet-privacy/marmot-ts imports)?

Does S18 comply with the architecture.md boundary rules: only `client/` constructs or disposes the MarmotClient, code inside HistoryBackend calls / inbox handlers / client listeners never awaits an account-scope client call (follow-up work via the owned setTimeout(0) FIFO), group sender identity comes only from orderingKey.account, and idb-keyval update() is not used? List each rule touched by this story's files with file:line evidence, or state why it is not touched.

Do unit, property, and (where the AC names them) library-harness or e2e tests cover the artifacts named in S18's scope (app/src/context/MarmotContext.tsx; app/src/context/ChatStoreContext.tsx; app/src/context/PollStoreContext.tsx; app/src/context/NostrIdentityContext.tsx; app/src/components/** IncomingCallWatcher, groups/*; app/src/hooks/useImageSend.ts, useDecryptedImage.ts)? Show that tests use real collaborators or test fixtures rather than mocking the helper used at the SUT call site, that idb mocks are seeded out of key order where order matters, and that at least one test fails if the production code is replaced by a no-op.

Does the delivered S18 implementation match the intent of its scope (Rewrite MarmotContext as a thin provider over client/, keeping the useMarmot() surface minus dead fields; switch ChatStore/PollStore sends, IncomingCallWatcher, useImageSend/useDecryptedImage, NostrIdentityContext perms (S2 builder + discard), settings relay save, pages and walled-garden reads to th) and respect its exclusions (Deleting old modules (S22); e2e spec rewrites (S24-S26))? Identify any capability owned by a later story that was built ahead, or any in-scope capability left unimplemented.

Does S18 follow project conventions (all new UI text in i18n.ts with en and de, no hardcoded user-visible strings, make-driven build/test, idb-keyval update() banned, no edits to app/ during an e2e run, and no leak of profile data to unaddressed audiences)? Cite evidence for each convention the story's files touch.

AC-CTXT-1: `MarmotContext` MUST keep the `useMarmot()` consumer surface minus fields with no consumer: every field name remaining on the returned object MUST have at least one consumer in `app/src` outside the context itself (grep-derived test), and every removed field (including `discoverable`, pairing-digest block, `getPendingRemovals`) MUST have none. Provide evidence of (a) the production code satisfying this (file:line), (b) the test(s) at level [unit (structural-behavioral hybrid) ] that exercise it end-to-end and would fail for a stub/no-op, and (c) confirmation that those tests are not pure mock-spy proxies.

AC-CTXT-2: `MarmotContext.tsx` MUST contain no protocol logic: it MUST NOT import `@941design/marmot` constructors directly (only through `lib/marmot/client`), and its line count MUST be under 1000. Provide evidence of (a) the production code satisfying this (file:line), (b) the test(s) at level [structural] that exercise it end-to-end and would fail for a stub/no-op, and (c) confirmation that those tests are not pure mock-spy proxies. Because the AC is structural, show the verification command's output on the pre-change tree and on the post-change tree and confirm they differ.

AC-CTXT-3: Re-homing is out of scope: `knownPeersRevision` and the DM/contacts reactivity counters MUST remain exposed by `useMarmot()` with unchanged semantics. Provide evidence of (a) the production code satisfying this (file:line), (b) the test(s) at level [unit; e2e:dm-walled-garden-* (kept)] that exercise it end-to-end and would fail for a stub/no-op, and (c) confirmation that those tests are not pure mock-spy proxies.

AC-CTXT-4: Walled-garden group-member predicate MUST read membership from the new API (live `group.members()` on the lease tab, overlay elsewhere); `dm-walled-garden-group-member-allowed`, `-retroactive-purge`, `-stranger-blocked` MUST keep their assertions. Provide evidence of (a) the production code satisfying this (file:line), (b) the test(s) at level [unit + e2e:dm-walled-garden-* (kept)] that exercise it end-to-end and would fail for a stub/no-op, and (c) confirmation that those tests are not pure mock-spy proxies.

AC-SEND-3: Chat, reactions, delete/edit, polls, image messages, call notices, profile exchange and announcements MUST each send through `sendGroupRumor`; a send of each type against a fake group MUST observe a `group.send` call with the expected kind (9, 7, 5, 10/11/12, poll kinds, 9 with imeta, call notice kind, 0, announcement kind). Provide evidence of (a) the production code satisfying this (file:line), (b) the test(s) at level [unit] that exercise it end-to-end and would fail for a stub/no-op, and (c) confirmation that those tests are not pure mock-spy proxies.

AC-INV-5: The invitation-pending live-update behaviour MUST be preserved: a new invitation arriving while the invitee page is idle appears without reload. Provide evidence of (a) the production code satisfying this (file:line), (b) the test(s) at level [e2e:groups-pending-invite-live-idle (kept)] that exercise it end-to-end and would fail for a stub/no-op, and (c) confirmation that those tests are not pure mock-spy proxies.

AC-MT-3: Cross-tab store-changed sync for group data MUST be removed (no `storage`/BroadcastChannel listener for group stores) while DM, contacts and block cross-tab sync MUST remain (`dm-block-cross-tab` unchanged). Provide evidence of (a) the production code satisfying this (file:line), (b) the test(s) at level [structural + e2e:dm-block-cross-tab (kept)] that exercise it end-to-end and would fail for a stub/no-op, and (c) confirmation that those tests are not pure mock-spy proxies. Because the AC is structural, show the verification command's output on the pre-change tree and on the post-change tree and confirm they differ.

AC-GATE-2: The cut-over story ends with the checkpoint subset run; the subset result is reported as a dev aid and MUST NOT be reported as a pass. Provide evidence of (a) the production code satisfying this (file:line), (b) the test(s) at level [structural (run report)] that exercise it end-to-end and would fail for a stub/no-op, and (c) confirmation that those tests are not pure mock-spy proxies. Because the AC is structural, show the verification command's output on the pre-change tree and on the post-change tree and confirm they differ.
